MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Taxonomy.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Taxonomy.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Taxonomy.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Taxonomy.

2. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel

   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

19. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

20. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

21. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
